summary.text: IT Management professional with an M.S. in Technology Management, experienced in regulatory compliance, operations coordination, and stakeholder communication. Resolved 100+ escalations, built MIS tracking systems that improved SLA adherence, and seeks an IT Project Manager or Business Analyst role.

bullets: Coordinated large-scale infrastructure projects, handling scheduling, resource allocation, labor supervision and milestone delivery
Tracked timelines with project managers, flagged risks and ensured 100% safety and quality compliance across concurrent workstreams
Managed stakeholder communication, produced progress reports and maintained logs, quality records and compliance documentation
Resolved 100+ high-priority regulatory and customer escalations, documenting full audit trails across risk, compliance, legal and tech teams
Translated operational requirements into IT and compliance workflows, acting as liaison between business and technical groups
Built MIS tracking systems to monitor metrics, SLA adherence and audit records, enabling data-driven reporting to senior management

projects.name: IT Management Capstone - Technology Strategy & Operations
projects.description: Created a technology adoption roadmap for a simulated organization, identifying gaps, risks and phased implementation using structured project management methods

projects.name: Structural Analysis Projects
projects.description: Modeled and tested engineering systems with STAAD Pro, producing technical documentation and data interpretation that translate to IT environments
